description: Standard test problems for validating gravity simulation correctness: Kepler orbit, figure-eight 3-body, Plummer sphere, hyperbolic encounter
mathematical_formalization: Kepler: T = 2pi*sqrt(a^3/GM), e = 1-r_min/a; Figure-8: periodic solution with T~6.3259; Plummer: rho(r) = 3M/(4pi*a^3) * (1+r^2/a^2)^(-5/2)
analogical_connections: unit testing in software (known correct answers)
implementation_hypothesis: Initial condition generators for each benchmark; validation metrics compare against analytical solutions within specified tolerances
experiment_seed: Run all benchmarks with leapfrog (dt=0.001) for 100 periods and measure energy drift, period error, trajectory deviation
